snippet.title: Quantic River - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Dive into the dystopian world of Quantic River. In this 2.5D cyberpunk action-adventure, you’ll master katana combat, exploit cybernetic augmentations, slice through destructible environments and hack your way through dual-layered levels built for speedrunners and explorers.  ￼

Unlock upgrades that enhance combat, mobility and hacking. Take control of security cameras, disable defenses and carve alternate routes through the megacity.  ￼

Add Quantic River to your wishlist now on Steam and get ready for an electrifying journey through the neon-lit underbelly of the future.
